item.text:
**3B.2 Research Note**

Bottom line: 2024 evidence is overwhelmingly negative. I found strong indications that Erdoğan’s government tolerated impunity for torture, enforced disappearances, and political imprisonment. The only meaningful pro-side evidence is a very limited accountability signal: one long-delayed torture case finally went to trial, which looks like an exception rather than a broader pattern.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Negative | [World Report 2024: Türkiye](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey | HRW says torture and ill-treatment in police/gendarmerie custody and prisons have rarely been rigorously investigated and even more rarely prosecuted; it also reports post-earthquake beatings and a death in gendarmerie custody. | 3B.2; 3B.1 |
| Negative | [UN Body to Examine Türkiye’s Record on Torture](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/16/un-body-examine-turkiyes-record-torture-0) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-07-16 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/16/un-body-examine-turkiyes-record-torture-0 | HRW says Türkiye’s torture record deteriorated greatly and that impunity persists; this is a direct indictment of failure to prevent or punish abuse by security forces. | 3B.2; 3B.1 |
| Positive, but very weak | [UN Body to Examine Türkiye’s Record on Torture](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/16/un-body-examine-turkiyes-record-torture-0) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-07-16 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/16/un-body-examine-turkiyes-record-torture-0 | The same HRW report notes a rare exception: after years of delay, three police officers and a doctor were finally set to face trial in the Eyüp Birinci torture case. This is evidence of some accountability, but only as an outlier. | 3B.2 |
| Negative | [Submission by Human Rights Watch on Türkiye to the Human Rights Committee](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/23/submission-human-rights-watch-turkiye-human-rights-committee) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-10-23 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/23/submission-human-rights-watch-turkiye-human-rights-committee | HRW says there was little evidence of effective investigations into enforced disappearances, and some victims may have been pressured not to file complaints. | 3B.2; 3B.1 |
| Negative | [Türkiye: Kurdish Politicians Convicted in Unjust Mass Trial](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/16/turkiye-kurdish-politicians-convicted-unjust-mass-trial) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-05-16 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/16/turkiye-kurdish-politicians-convicted-unjust-mass-trial | A Turkish court convicted 24 Kurdish politicians on bogus state-security charges in what HRW calls a manifestly political and unjust trial, with continued detention for many defendants. | 3B.2 |
| Negative | [Türkiye: Gezi Park defendants must be acquitted, and the chronicle of injustice brought to an end](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/press-release/2024/12/turkiye-gezi-park-defendants-must-be-acquitted-and-the-chronicle-of-injustice-brought-to-an-end/) | Amnesty International | 2024-12-09 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/press-release/2024/12/turkiye-gezi-park-defendants-must-be-acquitted-and-the-chronicle-of-injustice-brought-to-an-end/ | Amnesty says the Gezi prosecutions were politically motivated repression, with baseless charges sustained over years instead of lawful accountability. | 3B.2 |

Search gap: I did not find reliable 2024 evidence of a broad, Erdoğan-led accountability drive that systematically punished police, gendarmes, intelligence services, or prison officials for abuse. The positive evidence is limited to isolated or delayed court action, not a general pattern of prevention or punishment.
